name: tapp
description: The Tapp Agent Skill for iOS, Android, and web, plus Copilot tools and an auto-refreshing iOS simulator preview.

commands.title: Tapp: Forget saved values for an app

languageModelTools.name: tapp_open_app
languageModelTools.userDescription: Build (if needed) and open the iOS app on the simulator
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open an iOS app on the simulator and return the current screen as a structured accessibility summary. `target` is optional: omit it to auto-detect and build the Xcode project in the workspace (first build can take minutes), or pass a bundle id (com.example.app), a path to a simulator .app build, or a project directory. For a focused request, pass the user's named destination/control/task in `goal`: Tapp locates it from source and follows the shortest observed UI Map route before returning. Starts an interactive session that tapp_look and tapp_act use.

target.description: Optional: bundle id, path to .app, or project directory. Omit to auto-detect the workspace's Xcode project.

goal.description: Optional screen/control/task to source-locate and reach before returning, e.g. 'Save storefront settings visible above keyboard'

languageModelTools.name: tapp_look
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read and screenshot the current app screen
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Observe what is on the simulator screen right now: returns a screenshot of the open iOS app and, with `tree: true`, the structured accessibility snapshot (screen title, elements, controls, hittability — the iOS equivalent of read_page). Use it before acting and after each action instead of tapping from memory. Requires tapp_open_app first. Observation only; it changes nothing.

tree.description: Also return the structured accessibility tree of the current screen (default false: screenshot only)

languageModelTools.name: tapp_act
languageModelTools.userDescription: Tap, type, fill a field with a value you provide, or sign in
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Perform one interaction in the open iOS app and get the resulting screen back. `action` is one of: `tap` (element by accessibility id or visible label, case-insensitive contains fallback), `type` (text into the focused field, or into `id` first), `fill_field` (VS Code prompts the USER for the value and types it — the value never passes through you; use for codes, personal data, anything credential-like; set `secure` to mask), `login` (finds email + password fields, fills, submits and verifies in one call with secure-field handling done internally — ALWAYS use this for sign-in; omit `email`/`password` to let VS Code prompt the user, or pass `actor` to use repository actor bindings). Read the previous tapp_look result before acting. Requires tapp_open_app first.

id.description: tap/type/fill_field: accessibility id, label, or placeholder of the element or field

prompt.description: fill_field: question shown to the user, e.g. 'Enter the SMS verification code'

secure.description: fill_field: mask the user's input (passwords, codes)

actor.description: login: configured test actor from .tapp/project.json; environment bindings take precedence over saved Keychain values. Explicit credentials override actor bindings.

languageModelTools.name: tapp_explore
languageModelTools.userDescription: Autonomous exploration of the iOS app, or a read-only audit of a website
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Observe an application without an authored test and return an observation: findings, coverage, evidence page, screenshots and a recording. Three modes. (1) iOS exploration: omit `url`; `target` optional (same resolution as tapp_open_app), `maxActions` is the budget; takes minutes. (2) Read-only website audit: pass `url` — renders and reads, NEVER clicks, types, submits or hovers, so it is safe on production or a site the user does not own; finds dead controls, broken images/assets/links, failed requests, JS exceptions, mixed content, overflow; `pages` crawls same-origin links, `device` audits a mobile rendering. (3) Focused: pass `goal` with an open session to source-locate a named screen/control and take the shortest observed route in one call — if no observed route exists it returns exact source evidence and does not wander. Exploration is not a release gate: it returns no score or ship verdict. Report inconclusive coverage and the checked/not-checked scope honestly; use the Tapp CI gate for a merge decision.

target.description: iOS: optional bundle id, .app path, or project dir. Omit to auto-detect.

goal.description: Focused mode: the requested screen, control, or UI task to reach in the open app

url.description: Website mode: http(s) URL to audit read-only

pages.description: Website mode: same-origin pages to audit at most (default 1)

device.description: Website mode: optional Playwright device profile, e.g. "iPhone 13"

languageModelTools.name: tapp_build
languageModelTools.userDescription: Build the workspace's iOS app for the simulator and install it
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Build the iOS app from the Xcode project/workspace in the given directory (default: the workspace folder; container and scheme auto-detected), install it on the booted simulator, and return the bundle id. Use when the app is not installed yet or after code changes.

projectDir.description: Directory to search for the Xcode project (default: workspace folder)
